components: a long sweep from the left curling into a hook on the right
a short tick at the top
a long descender crossing the sweep
strokeOrder: begin on the left and sweep right, curling clockwise into the hook
lift; add the short tick at the top
lift; draw the long descender from the upper left down across the sweep to the lower right
strokeOrderNote: Sirgazil's 28-frame animation draws the long sweep FIRST and the descender LAST, which is the reverse of what the finished shape suggests; the marker moves twice, so there are two pen lifts.

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sirgazil, Hiragana や stroke order animation.gif, hiragana や, 28 frames, 2.8 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 1 October 2009)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The CC0 animation draws や as three strokes in the order sweep, tick, descender. KanjiVG's data for U+3084 holds three paths in the same order. The counter-intuitive part is the first stroke: the sweep and its hook are complete before the descender is begun.

notes: The ya of やっつ, eight things. Shares its first sound with よ and is built the other way round: よ begins with its crossing stroke, や ends with it.
